name: qa-flow-recorder
description: Runs a manual QA test case live against a booted simulator, driving both the screen and the network layer over MCP. Arms fixtures mutated from captured responses, proves they were served, drives the UI, reads real state, and adjudicates a disagreement as app-wrong, doc-wrong or undecided. Produces per-case screenshots, video, and a generated evidence report — not a compiled test file.
